title: Neural Signatures of Processing the Temporal Features of Auditory Events: From Preterm Infancy to Adulthood
official: Neural Signatures of Processing the Temporal Features of Auditory Events: From Preterm Infancy to Adulthood
summary: Premature neonates are able to discriminate phonemes and voice from 28wGA at a time the neuronal network establish contact between the environment and the cortical neurones. In the present monocentric study the investigators will analyse the response of the cortical network in premature aged between 25 and 36 wGA in response to auditory stimuli using High Resolution Electroencephalography and High Density Near Infrared Spectroscopy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* full term neonates between 25 and 36 weeks gestational age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Neonates outside the age range
